# I Don't Want To: The Violation of Burdensome Role Expectations

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Dana Yagil  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** Academy of Management Review  
**DOI:** [10.5465/amr.2023.0124](https://doi.org/10.5465/amr.2023.0124)

**Keywords:** role expectations, employee resistance, role violation, organizational behavior, psychological contract

## Abstract

Role expectations about how employees should behave are essential for organizational functioning but may occasionally conflict with individuals' preferences and well-being. This paper develops a theory of burdensome role expectations and examines how employees respond when such expectations are violated.
